module: Flowgraph node "Get Drag Race Times" (category repeat_instant). Gives in real time the timers of a vehicle (vehId pin) from gameplay_drag_dragBridge.getTimers. postInit dynamically creates, for each timer (reactionTime, dial, time_60, time_330, time_1_8, time_1000, time_1_4, velAt_1_8, velAt_1_4), a number output pin and a flow_<id> pin (pulse when the timer is recorded). Fixed output: timer.
notes: The timer distances are in meters (60 ft = 18.288, 1/4 mile = 402.336).
The "timer" pin is declared in pinSchema, but only the bridge timers with isSet true and type different from 'timer' feed the flow_/value pins.

postInit.desc: Creates the flow_<id> and number <id> pins for each timer.

updateInfos.desc: Gets the vehicle's timers via the bridge; reports a node error if vehId is missing or unknown.

work.desc: Calls updateInfos and copies the set timers to the pins.
